activities.title: Code; Without Barriers Meetup Bangkok
activities.description: This event was organized by Microsoft (Thailand) in collaboration with the Thai Programmer Association. It provided an opportunity for women in the technology field to meet and share experiences with speakers from Microsoft, LSEG, Coraline, and Women Techmakers Bangkok.

activities.title: Macro Business Simulation Competition
activities.description: Participated in the MBS (Macro Business Simulation) competition, which is a cloud-based platform that simulates a business environment and generates financial reports every quarter. This provided an opportunity to learn about management and business simulation.

activities.title: Code in The Wind #2

activities.title: Chimnovate Hackathon 2022

activities.title: 3rd Place – BU Mini Hackathon 2025
